name: radial-gauge
title: Radial gauge
author: Eduardo Retana
description: A half-circle meter with ticks and a needle. Values above max are labelled over budget and the needle stops at the end. gauge remains the filled arc.

meta.descriptionEs: Un semicírculo con marcas y aguja. Si el valor pasa el máximo, lo dice y la aguja se detiene.

examples.title: Medidor radial
examples.description: Dentro del tope y por encima.

api.name: ticks
api.description: Tick marks along the arc. Default 5.

api.name: formatter / overLabel / tone
api.description: Value text, the over-budget label, and the stroke tone.

api.name: variant="ticks"
api.description: Ticks draws 12–48 marks and no needle. suffix appends to the value. The default stays arc.

docs: Independent implementation of a common dashboard pattern. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite a primitive the host already has.
